name: App CTA Clicked
description: Fires when a Hent appen button in the nav, the founder video or How it works is clicked; it scrolls to the store badges.

name: Store Badge Clicked
description: Fires server-side and anonymously when an App Store or Google Play badge is clicked. Properties: store, position.

name: Newsletter Signup
description: Fires server-side and anonymously for every accepted newsletter form submit, whatever happened to the address. Property: scope.

name: Founder Video Played
description: Fires when the user clicks play on the founder video.

name: Waitlist Signup Confirmed
description: Fires server-side when the API confirms a successful waitlist signup.
